scope: Independent, outcome-blind grouping of the locked IDEA-068 20-dimensional acoustic feature cache for IDEA-082 protocol review.

features.name: log_f0_q10
features.physical_meaning: Lower-tail voiced fundamental-frequency level on the natural-log scale.
features.extractor_definition: 10th percentile of log(F0) over pYIN-voiced frames.

features.name: log_f0_median
features.physical_meaning: Typical voiced fundamental-frequency level on the natural-log scale.
features.extractor_definition: Median of log(F0) over pYIN-voiced frames.

features.name: log_f0_q90
features.physical_meaning: Upper-tail voiced fundamental-frequency level on the natural-log scale.
features.extractor_definition: 90th percentile of log(F0) over pYIN-voiced frames.

features.name: log_f0_iqr
features.physical_meaning: Robust within-call F0 span or intonational dispersion.
features.extractor_definition: 75th minus 25th percentile of voiced log(F0).
overlap: source_stability_and_periodicity: mixes intended contour movement with irregular or unstable F0 estimates

features.name: log_f0_std
features.physical_meaning: Global within-call variation of voiced log(F0).
features.extractor_definition: Population standard deviation of voiced log(F0).
overlap: f0_level_and_contour: also responds to deliberate intonation and range, not only instability

features.name: log_f0_mad
features.physical_meaning: Robust global within-call deviation of voiced log(F0) around its median.
features.extractor_definition: Median absolute deviation of voiced log(F0).

features.name: log_f0_slope
features.physical_meaning: Overall rising or falling F0 trajectory across the call.
features.extractor_definition: Least-squares slope of voiced log(F0) against call-normalized frame time.
overlap: source_stability_and_periodicity: unreliable voicing tracks can perturb the fitted slope

features.name: log_f0_abs_delta_median
features.physical_meaning: Typical frame-to-frame change in voiced log(F0).
features.extractor_definition: Median absolute difference between consecutive voiced-frame log(F0) values.
overlap: f0_level_and_contour: fast intentional modulation and tracking instability are not separable

features.name: period_variation_proxy
features.physical_meaning: Frame-scale relative variation of the estimated glottal period.
features.extractor_definition: Median absolute difference of consecutive 1/F0 estimates divided by median 1/F0.

features.name: voiced_fraction
features.physical_meaning: Fraction of analysis frames accepted as voiced by pYIN.
features.extractor_definition: Mean of the finite-positive F0 mask over all frames.
overlap: pitch-tracker reliability rather than a pure physiological source measure

features.name: voiced_probability_mean
features.physical_meaning: Average pYIN posterior support for voicing.
features.extractor_definition: Mean finite voiced-probability output from pYIN.

features.name: voiced_probability_std
features.physical_meaning: Variation in pYIN posterior support for voicing across the call.
features.extractor_definition: Population standard deviation of finite pYIN voiced probabilities.
overlap: algorithm confidence, call segmentation, and signal-to-noise conditions

features.name: periodicity_median
features.physical_meaning: Typical normalized autocorrelation strength at the pYIN-estimated F0 lag.
features.extractor_definition: Median of framewise normalized autocorrelation, clipped to [0, 0.999].
overlap: near-redundant with hnr_db_median because HNR is a monotonic transform of the same framewise periodicity

features.name: hnr_db_median
features.physical_meaning: Typical periodic-to-aperiodic energy ratio expressed in decibels.
features.extractor_definition: Median of 10*log10(r/(1-r)), where r is the same clipped framewise autocorrelation used by periodicity_median.

features.name: amplitude_variation_proxy
features.physical_meaning: Frame-scale relative amplitude modulation on voiced frames.
features.extractor_definition: Median absolute consecutive-frame RMS difference divided by median voiced-frame RMS.
overlap: spectral_energy: intentional amplitude envelope and recording level dynamics contribute

features.name: log_rms_median
features.physical_meaning: Typical voiced-frame broadband energy on the natural-log scale.
features.extractor_definition: Median log(RMS + 1e-10) over voiced frames.

features.name: log_rms_iqr
features.physical_meaning: Robust within-call spread of voiced-frame broadband energy.
features.extractor_definition: 75th minus 25th percentile of voiced log(RMS + 1e-10).

features.name: spectral_tilt_median
features.physical_meaning: Typical rate at which spectral magnitude decreases or increases with frequency between 200 and 4000 Hz.
features.extractor_definition: Median voiced-frame OLS slope of log magnitude against log frequency from 200 to 4000 Hz.
overlap: source-filter ambiguity: glottal-source slope and vocal-tract or recording coloration are not separated

features.name: spectral_tilt_iqr
features.physical_meaning: Robust within-call variation of spectral tilt.
features.extractor_definition: 75th minus 25th percentile of voiced-frame log-log spectral slopes from 200 to 4000 Hz.

features.name: spectral_flatness_median
features.physical_meaning: Typical noise-like versus tonal spectral distribution on voiced frames.
features.extractor_definition: Median librosa spectral flatness over voiced frames.

hard_audit_requirements: The three primary groups must be disjoint and exhaust the exact ordered IDEA-068 20-feature schema.
The locked IDEA-068 cache must be reused byte-for-byte and its SHA-256 verified before any fit.
Missing-value medians and standardization statistics must be fit on the current training cats only and then applied unchanged to validation cats.
Cat IDs, not calls, are the split and aggregation unit; no cat may cross train and validation within a fit.
Acoustic extraction and grouping may not read age labels or outcome metrics.
Paired variants must share common initialization, cat batch order, checkpoint rule, seed, repeat, and fold.
Outer-test access and predictions must remain false.
Paired reporting must retain seed/repeat/fold cells and animal-level validation metrics; calls are not independent replicates.
